update_description: The alias np.float_ has been removed and replaced with np.float64.
The alias np.complex_ has been removed and replaced with np.complex128.
The alias np.longfloat has been removed and replaced with np.longdouble.
The alias np.singlecomplex has been removed and replaced with np.complex64.
The alias np.cfloat has been removed and replaced with np.complex128.
The alias np.longcomplex has been removed and replaced with np.clongdouble.
The alias np.clongfloat has been removed and replaced with np.clongdouble.
The alias np.string_ has been removed and replaced with np.bytes_.
The alias np.unicode_ has been removed and replaced with np.str_.
The aliases np.Inf have been removed and replaced with np.inf.
The aliases np.Infinity have been removed and replaced with np.inf.
The aliases np.infty have been removed and replaced with np.inf.
The alias np.mat has been removed and replaced with np.asmatrix.
The alias np.issubclass_ has been removed and replaced with the built-in issubclass function.
The alias np.asfarray has been removed and replaced with np.asarray with a proper dtype.
The np.tracemalloc_domain has been moved to np.lib and is now only available from np.lib.
The function np.recfromcsv has been removed and replaced with np.genfromtxt with comma delimiter.
The function np.recfromtxt has been removed and replaced with np.genfromtxt with comma delimiter.
The np.dtype("a") alias for np.dtype(np.bytes_) has been deprecated and replaced with np.dtype("S").

update_info: removed, replaced by using the context manager with np.errstate()
update_description: The function np.geterrobj has been removed. The preferred replacement is using the context manager with np.errstate().
code_example:
with np.errstate():
    # code that may raise floating-point errors

update_info: removed, replaced by using the context manager with np.errstate()
update_description: The function np.seterrobj has been removed. The preferred replacement is using the context manager with np.errstate().
code_example:
with np.errstate():

update_description: np.cast has been removed. The literal replacement for np.cast[dtype](arg) is np.asarray(arg, dtype=dtype).
np.source has been removed. The preferred replacement is inspect.getsource.
np.set_string_function has been removed. Use np.set_printoptions with a formatter for custom printing of NumPy objects.

update_info: deprecated, replaced by np.trapezoid or scipy.integrate
update_description: np.trapz has been deprecated. Use np.trapezoid or a scipy.integrate function instead.
code_example:
from scipy.integrate import trapezoid
result = trapezoid(y, x)

update_description: np.in1d has been deprecated. Use np.isin instead.
Alias np.row_stack has been deprecated. Use np.vstack directly.
Deprecated np.deprecate and np.deprecate_with_doc have been removed from the main namespace. Use DeprecationWarning instead.
np.safe_eval has been deprecated. Use ast.literal_eval instead.

update_info: removed, replaced by numpy.promote_types or numpy.result_type
update_description: np.find_common_type has been removed. Use numpy.promote_types or numpy.result_type instead. To achieve semantics for the scalar_types argument, use numpy.result_type and pass 0, 0.0, or 0j as a Python scalar instead.
np.round_ has been removed. Use np.round instead.
np.nbytes has been removed. Use np.dtype(<dtype>).itemsize instead.
np.compare_chararrays has been removed from the main namespace. Use np.char.compare_chararrays instead.
np.format_parser has been removed from the main namespace. Use np.rec.format_parser instead.
np.msort has been removed. For a replacement, np.sort(a, axis=0) should be used instead.

update_info: removed, now raises an error; use arr.size > 0 instead
update_description: bool(np.array([])) and other empty arrays will now raise an error. Use arr.size > 0 instead to check whether an array has no elements. (gh-27160)
